articles.title: PayPal Ads Launches Transaction Graph Insights and Measurement to Improve Commerce Advertising Outcomes
articles.mainIdea: PayPal Ads Launches Transaction Graph Insights and Measurement to Improve Commerce Advertising Outcomes
articles.summary: PR Newswire: PayPal Ads Launches Transaction Graph Insights and Measurement to Improve Commerce Advertising Outcomes. PayPal today announced the launch of PayPal's Transaction Graph Insights & Measurement program, providing merchants & advertisers with a unique, cross-merchant view into real shopper behavior, campaign effectiveness, and data-driven recommendations to grow their business. PayPal's Transaction Graph Insights & Measurement creates the full dimensionality of a consumer purchase, and with full sales signal integrity and accuracy.
